title: ADR-005: Business run data and trace data are separate
summary: docs/adr/ADR-005-observability-split.md · 原文保留历史日期；先学主课程，需要核查时再读。
html:
Status: Accepted in M0.

AgentHub owns durable Run/Step business records beginning in M4. OTel/Langfuse receives safe projections from a TraceSink; it is optional, content capture is opt-in, and its availability cannot make core business requests fail.
